surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: Caller-provided `executable` path string and `arguments` string list.
TRUST: Policy mandates exactly one permitted binary `/usr/bin/printf`, direct vector argument passing, and disabled shell/command-interpreter processing.
SINK: Subprocess execution that runs an external binary and captures its standard output stream.
GUARD: Reject with ValueError unless `executable` is exactly `/usr/bin/printf`; invoke the binary with arguments as a direct vector and without shell interpretation.
ORDER: Validate executable string first, then spawn the fixed binary with the supplied argument vector, then read and decode the complete stdout.
EFFECT: Return captured stdout as text; raise ValueError for any disallowed executable; propagate process failure exceptions unchanged.
END_PLAN
